product_one_liner.value: Obsidian provides enterprise security teams with a platform to discover, govern, and protect SaaS applications and AI agents, including detecting identity threats and SaaS supply-chain risks.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its platform as SaaS security across business apps, with products for AI-agent security.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page exists and lists a free plan and quote-based plans.

named_customers.notes: Both are presented in customer stories; the customer page identifies TELUS and Algolia as customers.

employee_band.notes: Revelio Labs reports 250 employees worldwide as of June 2026, placing the company in this band. LinkedIn gives a broader 51–200 range.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists the headquarters as Palo Alto, California.

founded_year.notes: Both the company profile and careers page identify 2017 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog index is primarily product, threat-education, and marketing content; it does not show at least two posts by engineers explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation/footer does not identify public product documentation or a developer/help portal; the Trust Center is for security documentation, not product docs.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board includes titles such as AI Security Engineer, Agent Security Research Engineer, and Software Engineer - AI Security Product.

model_provider.notes: Checked the public Trust Center and company AI/product materials; they do not state which model or model provider Obsidian uses in its own product.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center also names ISO/IEC 27701 and ISO/IEC 42001, but this answer lists only certifications from the categories requested.

last_funding.notes: The company announced an $85 million Series D on August 4, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2026 Series D falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current openings include multiple Enterprise Account Executive positions.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest product-launch announcement identified in the readable news history is the end-to-end SaaS supply-chain security launch dated January 22, 2026, before the May 9–November 9, 2026 window. Later dated news includes funding or partnership announcements rather than product launches.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current leadership page is small enough to review; no join or departure within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 was identified. The most recent cited leadership appointments were announced July 9, 2025, outside the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Obsidian has a page describing its security integration for Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This is a visible product-integration signal, not evidence that Obsidian uses it internally as its own CRM.
